name: liquid-glass-sidebar-menu

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the whole panel centred with all five rows and the active pill visible.

tagline: A dark glass menu panel with icon rows floats over a mossy photo.
summary: A narrow rounded sidebar of five icon-and-label rows — Dashboard, Search, Sales Analytics, Notification and Account Settings — on a smoky glass panel over a photo, with the active row as a white pill.
appearance: A tall dark rounded panel, about 280px wide, sits over a photo of mossy stone and water. Five full-width rows each pair a small line icon with a label; the top row is a white pill with dark text, the rest are white text on near-black glass. A soft edge highlight outlines the panel.
behaviour: The panel can be grabbed and dragged as a whole, springing back toward its start when released. Menu rows lighten to a translucent white wash on hover, and the current Dashboard row stays a filled white pill.
demo_content: Menu labels Dashboard, Search, Sales Analytics, Notification and Account Settings over a mossy ruin photo.
search_phrases: vertical menu with active white pill
glassy menu list for an app
use_when: You want a floating app menu that keeps the background photo visible behind it.
avoid_when: It is a fixed 280px panel with hardcoded destinations and no collapse, so it cannot shrink on phones.
customise: Menu labels, icons and destinations are written into the JSX; blur, shadow, glow, radius and the draggable flag come from the card props. The 280px width is set by a class.
weight_why: One blurred glass panel with a displacement filter and five simple buttons.

a11y.note: Buttons are keyboard reachable but have no visible focus ring, and dragging is pointer-only.

issues: The fixed 280px panel has no collapse control, so it cannot shrink on small screens.
The panel sits on a busy photo, so its edges are hard to separate from the background.
polish_why: Neat rows and a clear active pill; the glass reads more like a dark scrim than glass.
